verdict.line: You lose this lane if you facetank Gwen's true-damage Q stacks or walk into a fresh Hallowed Mist; you win it by extracting her spirit with E from range and chaining W leaps near terrain before her kit resets.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's entire edge in this matchup comes from the E-into-Vessel loop stacking Tentacle damage onto Gwen faster than Gwen's Q poke and passive can out-heal it, but that loop only works if you land E before Gwen gets Hallowed Mist up. The 1,740-game sample gives Illaoi lane and solo-kill advantage despite a near-coinflip 49.5% raw win rate, which means this is a sequencing matchup, not a free one.

theirWindow.when: Hallowed Mist (W) is up and she's spacing
theirWindow.what: She can port into the mist and become untargetable from outside it, which whiffs your E (Test of Spirit, 900 range) entirely. Don't commit your full combo into a Gwen who's holding W — poke with E from max range first to bait it out.

yourWindow.when: Hallowed Mist (W) just went down, CD 22-18s
yourWindow.what: Immediately E (Test of Spirit) her spirit from 900 range before she can reset it, then W (Harsh Lesson, 4s CD, 400 range) leap in to dump Q and auto damage onto the spirit for the echo while nearby Tentacles swing too.

powerCurve.note: W leap trades into her Q poke evenly
E unlocks the spirit/Vessel all-in window
R adds AoE Tentacle spawn, snowballs hard
her R poke and kiting offset your tankiness

start.why: Highest-performing start in the sample (50% WR, 45.2% pick) — the extra damage and sustain fuel the early W-into-E all-in instead of a passive lane.

boots.why: 42.9% WR and 70% pick on this matchup — the magic resist and tenacity blunt A Thousand Cuts stacking and her Needlework slow.

core.why: Highest-WR core path (50% over this build order) and the spellshield directly answers Gwen's magic burst windows off E (Skip 'n Slash).
Armor shred amplifies every Tentacle swing and Q (Tentacle Smash) hit once you're sticking to her in the Vessel loop.
On-hit slow helps you stay attached through her E (Skip 'n Slash) attack-speed window instead of letting her kite the spirit away.

situational.when: gwen's r poke is chipping you down over repeated skirmishes and you need more healing off tentacle procs
gwen is building burst and threatens to flip an all-in on you after level 6
you're already ahead on lane tempo and want to snowball the skirmish window at levels 3-5

runes.keystoneWhy: This matchup's winning pattern is an extended skirmish — E extract, W leap, Q smash, Tentacle swings — not a one-shot burst, so Conqueror's stacking adaptive force and healing scale with the loop better than a single Grasp proc. The measured sample backs this: this page runs 80% WR versus the Grasp page's 27.3%, even on a smaller sample.

summoners.why: Highest-WR combo in the sample (50% WR, 40% pick). Teleport lets you leverage the lane-advantage shape of this matchup into the rest of the map once the Vessel loop snowballs; Flash covers the gap-close or the escape if her E (Skip 'n Slash) attack-speed window catches you overextended. Exhaust+Flash (45.5% WR) is the safer alt if you want a hard answer to her on-hit burst instead.

playing.title: Extract spirit before engaging
playing.detail: Open with E (Test of Spirit, 900 range, CD 16-12s) before you close distance, so the echo captures trade damage even if she later denies your melee follow-up with Hallowed Mist.

playing.title: Leap the instant E lands
playing.detail: Follow immediately with W (Harsh Lesson, 4s CD, 400 range) onto Gwen or the spirit — it pulls nearby Tentacles into the swing and starts the Vessel clock before she can disengage.

playing.title: Fight near impassible terrain
playing.detail: Your passive Tentacles only spawn on nearby impassible terrain, so position skirmishes toward walls or jungle edges where Q (Tentacle Smash, CD 10-6s, 850 range) and passive swings actually connect.

playing.title: Respect her true damage stacks
playing.detail: Gwen's Q (Snip Snip!, CD 6.5-3.5s) deals true damage to the center target on every snip and builds A Thousand Cuts — don't facetank a long extended trade at low HP where that bonus magic damage spikes.

playing.title: Bait Hallowed Mist early
playing.detail: Poke with E from max range to force her to pop W (Hallowed Mist, CD 22-18s) defensively; once it's down, your full E-W-Q combo goes through clean.

playing.title: Track her E dash window
playing.detail: Gwen's E (Skip 'n Slash, CD 13-11s, 400 range) grants attack speed, range, and on-hit magic damage for a few seconds after the dash — if she just used it, don't trade autos, land your own W leap first.

playing.title: Hold R for grouped moments
playing.detail: R (Leap of Faith, CD 120-70s, 450 range) spawns a Tentacle per champion hit, so it's wasted 1v1 early at a 120s cooldown — save it for all-ins or skirmishes where it hits multiple targets.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning, timing windows, and trade sequencing are my own analysis built on top of that data.
